title: Olympia
summary: Olympia is a sanctuary of Zeus in a valley of the western Peloponnese, Greece. UNESCO describes its sacred precinct, the Altis, as a major sanctuary from the 10th century BC to the 4th century AD, and the site of the Olympic Games from 776 BC to 393 AD.

uncertainty.note: Start is the 10th century BC as a whole (UNESCO); Games dated 776 BC to 393 AD. Year -999 is the first year of that century.

as_recorded.value: 10th century BC to the 4th century AD

where.modern_name: Archaeological Site of Olympia, Ilia, West Greece, Greece
where.historical_name: Olympia, sanctuary of Zeus (Altis), in Elis

importance.justification: Panhellenic sanctuary of Zeus and home of the ancient Olympic Games, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

sources.title: Olympia: The Site (Perseus Project, Olympics exhibit)

reviewer_note: Coordinates are UNESCO's DMS (N37 38 24 E21 38 2.4) converted to decimal, the site centre point. Start date is a century-wide UNESCO phrasing; Perseus only confirms the Altis was the Zeus sanctuary and Games setting.
